subject: POC Telemetry: stewardship, success indicators & export playbook
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 16:15:00 +0000
Subject: POC Telemetry: stewardship, success indicators & export playbook

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a shared checklist to get the POC running next month. I pulled this together with Aditya (SE) and Marissa (CS).

High-level goal
- Verify that Redwood can meet Acme Analytics' latency and signal fidelity requirements for the Recommendations service in a 2-week trial, with particular focus on end-to-end tracing and log export for post-hoc model fidelity checks.

Minimum success indicators (please confirm):
1) 95th percentile generation latency <= 120ms for 512-token sequences under your baseline traffic (we agreed to a 5rps test harness).
2) Full trace capture (distributed tracing) for request -> model -> cache paths, visible in your tracing UI.
3) Log export to S3 (or your GCS bucket) with structured token-level logs for a 48-hour sample window.
4) No data residency violations — all PII redaction rules apply.

Proposed POC scope & deliverables
- Week 0 (kickoff): onboarding, credentials exchange, basic smoke tests.
- Week 1: telemetry baseline capture — traces, request/response metrics, token-level logs to export.
- Week 2: targeted load runs + failure injection (latency spike/cold start) and dashboarding.
- Deliverables: dashboard pack (Grafana templates), trace examples, exported log samples, short runbook for reproducing failures.

Ownership
- Redwood: Aditya (SE) — instrumentation config, dashboard templates, run the load tests. Marissa (CS) — onboarding, success measurement, account coordination.
- Acme: Alex (Eng lead) — provide sample traffic/harness, bucket credentials for export, success sign-off. Priya (Ops) — security/compliance contact.

Immediate asks for kickoff
- Alex: confirm the success indicators above and the test window you prefer (we suggested starting Mon 29 Nov).
- Provide credentials (read-only bucket or S3 temp creds) and a small sample of expected request traces (5–10 payloads).

I've attached a draft POC stewardship workbook and a short observability spec Aditya will flesh out.

Thanks —
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
---

Hannah —

Thanks for the clear recap. Confirming the success indicators with two minor tweaks:
- Latency: 95th percentile target is fine but can relax to <=150ms during burst (+10rps) tests.
- Log export: prefer GCS; we'll provide a service account with write permissions to a test bucket.

We can start the test window on Mon 29 Nov as suggested. I'll send the sample payloads and the bucket creds by EOD Tue. Priya will be our compliance contact; she'll follow up with a short questionnaire on redaction rules.

One more ask — can Redwood provide a brief dashboard that highlights model-side token emission rates and per-request cache hit/miss rates? Those will help our model team reconcile hits against recommendations quality.

—Alex
Alex Turner
Engineering Lead, Acme Analytics

Alex —

Great, thanks for the quick confirm. Below is a compact observability plan tailored to your asks; I attached wireframes for the dashboards (dashboard-wireframes.png).

Observability plan (short):
- Traces: enable distributed tracing at the API ingress (request id propagation) + model executor spans (kv cache, kernel exec). We'll export traces to your Jaeger endpoint and keep a parallel copy in our short-term retention for debugging.
- Metrics: expose per-request metrics (latency.p50/p95/p99, tokens.emitted, cache.hit_ratio) via Prometheus scrape endpoint. We'll provide Grafana dashboards with templated variables for environment/test-id.
- Logs: structured JSON logs with fields {request_id, user_id_hash, prompt_hash, tokens_emitted, latency_ms, cache_hit}. We'll push batch exports to your GCS bucket every 30 minutes during the 48-hour sample window.
- Dashboard specifics you requested: model-side token emission rate (tokens/s per model shard); cache hit/miss by keyspace; request-level score distributions (if you can provide the ranking score field).

Security/compliance notes
- PII redaction: we'll strip or hash user identifiers prior to export. If there are fields you need removed, send a schema and we'll add redaction rules.
- Access: we'll only write to the test bucket with the service account you provide; no longer-term retention beyond 30 days without explicit sign-off.

Proposed runbook snippet for the test run (attached in workbook):
1) Setup credentials and secrets in Redwood console (Hannah/Marissa assist).
2) Smoke: 30m synthetic at 1rps to confirm traces & exports.
3) Baseline: 4h steady at 5rps capture sample window.
4) Burst: ramp to 15rps for 30m to validate p95 under load.

Can we schedule a 30-minute technical sync Wed 25 Nov at 10am PST to finalize the dashboard variables?

Thanks —
Aditya
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
